errors.evidence: This phrasing inaccurately describes the structure. It treats the inner categories ("Contradiction Resolution," etc.) as abstract groupings rather than distinct visual elements (the colored wedges in the inner circle). A more accurate description would state that the outer ring segments are visually grouped under the corresponding wedges of the inner ring.

The prompt asks to include the color for each slice. The description fails to mention the specific colors of the nine outer segments (shades of red, blue, and green/teal) or the three inner segments (brown-red, dark blue, dark green), only mentioning generically that the inner ring has "color-coded wedge[s]."

When listing the capabilities that exceed 100, the description omits "Recursive Reasoning," which has a value of 110.

The numbers shown in the figure do not reflect the caption's total; they contradict it. The model is hallucinating a reconciliation between two conflicting data points.
